proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3197 kīdṛśa gives kiso/kis and the analogically remodelled kaïsa/kaisā series. These simple s-bearing what-kind forms fit that interrogative family. Forms without s need separate comparison with other interrogative bases. Reviewed comparison: H kaisa “what kind?” (f_v3xb4cwz2ijg2). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
